prompt: A patient requested their full medical records eight months ago and we still haven't produced them. What's our exposure?
assertions: States the deadline: 30 days from receipt, with one 30-day extension with written notice (45 CFR 164.524(b)) — eight months is a clear violation
Cites the Right of Access Initiative enforcement track record — dozens of settlements (55 actions through August 2026), including the Azul Vision settlement ($50,000, August 2026, ~2-year delay)
Describes exposure: civil monetary penalties or resolution amount plus a corrective action plan (policy revisions, training, monitoring)
States the substantive duties: provide access in the form and format requested if readily producible, including electronic copies
Notes fee limits: only a reasonable, cost-based fee (labor/supplies/postage) is permitted
